name: BlueRush Inc.
summary: BlueRush Inc., operating through its BlueRush Digital Media Corp. subsidiary, delivers a comprehensive Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform designed for marketing and sales enablement. This solution empowers organizations to effectively engage with their customer base across Canada, the United States, and other North American territories. A cornerstone of their offerings is IndiVideo, an interactive and personalized video platform dedicated to extracting valuable data and insights from customer video interactions. BlueRush serves a broad spectrum of industries, including financial services (banking, mortgages, investments, and retirement), insurance, healthcare, real estate, telecommunications, marketing agencies, utilities, and non-profit sectors. The company, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Toronto, Canada, was formerly known as BlueRush Media Group Corp. before rebranding to BlueRush Inc. in April 2018.
